settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the language for the Context Canvas interface.
codex.title: Import Codex session
codex.description: No hook or background service is required. Codex exports a local file, then the browser parses it on this machine.
codex.copyCopied: Export instruction copied. Switch to the target Codex task, paste it, and send it.
codex.copyFailed: The browser could not copy automatically. Use the button to copy it.
codex.stepOneTitle: Send the instruction in the target Codex task
codex.stepOneBody: Codex uses the unique marker to locate this rollout and exports the records before the instruction.
codex.stepTwoTitle: Allow the required local file permissions
codex.stepTwoBody: If prompted, allow reading the Codex sessions directory and writing the Context Canvas Imports folder.
codex.stepThreeBody: The original session file is not changed and content is not uploaded.
codex.dropHint: or click to choose a .jsonl file
codex.boundaryVerified: Import boundary verified: the export instruction and Codex response are excluded. Tools and sub-agent records are marked needs review and are excluded from the bundle by default.
codex.boundaryWaiting: The file will be checked against the unique marker or export filename before import.
complex.noBlocks: No readable blocks in this turn.
notice.importSummary: {{file}} imported as one Complex Chat with {{count}} turns.
ui.importDescription: Paste text, choose a local markdown/plain-text/docx file, or add a screenshot.
ui.title: Title
ui.pastePlaceholder: Paste copied chat or notes here...
ui.readerHint: Select text in the preview, then mark it for the bundle. Source imports are read-only and will not be changed.
ui.noReadableTextBody: The file node was created, but no readable document text came through. Try importing again, or paste the document text directly.
ui.changesAutosaved: Changes are saved in the workspace automatically.
ui.drawBbox: Drag on the image to draw a bounding box.
ui.placeTextBox: Click or drag on the image to place a text box.
ui.label: Label
ui.selectNodeBody: Use the canvas to inspect sources, edit blocks, and prepare a bundle.
ui.shapeHint: The shape is visual shorthand. The optional meaning is included in structured output as a helper field.
ui.startNodeBody: This is the default entry point for source context. New imports stay unconnected until you decide how the canvas should flow.
ui.readerBlockHint: Preview and selection live in the center reader. This panel edits the structured blocks that feed the bundle.
ui.bundleNodeBody: This node represents the current output package. Use the preview panel to inspect what Codex will see.
ui.endNodeBody: This is the default output point. Use its canvas controls or the top Bundle button to export the current bundle.
ui.newCanvasBody: This clears the current workspace view and saves the new empty canvas locally.
ui.downloadFirst: Download the current bundle first if you want to keep the output from this canvas.
ui.dropFiles: Drop markdown, text, docx, png, jpeg, or jpg files
ui.localFilesImmediate: Local files become canvas nodes immediately.
ui.autoLater: Auto orchestration later. For now, you make the context calls.
ui.importOrConnect: Import or connect sources from here.
ui.invalidCodexFile: Choose a Codex-exported .jsonl file. Use the regular Import for documents.
ui.markerMismatch: This file has neither the current marker nor the expected export filename. Copy the instruction again and drop the newly generated file.
ui.fileReadError: The browser could not read this file. Please choose it again.
ui.fileReadErrorDetail: The browser could not read this file: {{detail}}
ui.imageReadError: {{file}} could not be read as an image: {{detail}} The original file was not changed.
ui.docxNoText: {{file}} was added, but the DOCX parser did not find readable body text. The original file was not changed.
ui.docxImportError: {{file}} could not be imported as DOCX: {{detail}} The original file was not changed.
ui.emptyText: {{file}} was added, but no readable text came through. The original file was not changed.
ui.textReadError: {{file}} could not be read as text: {{detail}} The original file was not changed.
ui.unsupportedFile: {{file}} is not a supported import type yet. Use markdown, txt, docx, png, jpeg, or jpg.
diagnostic.TRAILING_PARTIAL_LINE: The final JSONL record was incomplete and was ignored.
diagnostic.INVALID_JSON_LINE: Line {{line}} was not valid JSON and was ignored.
diagnostic.CORRUPT_JSONL: Line {{line}} is corrupt, so the import stopped to protect turn boundaries.
diagnostic.EMPTY_FILE: The file contains no readable JSONL records.
diagnostic.AMBIGUOUS_MARKER: Multiple turns contain the export marker, so the import boundary is ambiguous.
diagnostic.MARKER_NOT_FOUND: The current export marker was not found in a user message.
diagnostic.SESSION_ID_MISSING: This does not look like a complete Codex rollout: no session id was found.
diagnostic.MULTIPLE_SESSIONS: The file contains multiple Codex sessions and was not imported.
diagnostic.NO_USER_TURNS: No importable user turns were found. Make sure this is a complete Codex rollout JSONL file.
